mapper.select: SELECT l.id, l.post_id AS postId, p.title AS postTitle, p.content AS postContent, p.images AS postImages, p.user_id AS authorId, u.username AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.like_count AS likeCount, l.create_time FROM t_community_like l LEFT JOIN t_community_post p ON l.post_id = p.id AND p.deleted_flag = 0 AND p.status = 1 LEFT JOIN t_user u ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY l.create_time DESC
